title: Ship Inbound Order
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-11
html:
Path: /fbt/202603/ship_inbound_order

Method: [POST]

Function Description

Finalizes carton and shipping details for an inbound order that is ready to ship. For an order that has not already been shipped, a successful response means the details were saved and the order moved to the receiving stage. Repeating the request after the order has already been shipped returns success without applying the supplied details again.

Request Body Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
inbound_order_id string Y 5766071177167344427 Identifier of the inbound order to ship.
cartons []object N Carton details. Required when the inbound plan was created or updated using goods_items instead of cartons and the order has not already been shipped. Not required when retrying an order that has already been shipped.
^carton_type string Y SINGLE_SKU Carton composition type.
Possible values:
  • SINGLE_SKU - items must contain exactly one goods item.
  • MULTI_SKU - items must contain more than one goods item. | ^items |[]object |Y | |Goods item list of a carton. | ^^goods_id |string |Y |723456789012345678 |Identifier of the goods item in the carton. | ^^quantity |int |Y |100 |Number of units of this goods item in each carton represented by the parent carton entry. Must be greater than 0. | ^^lot_code |string |N |sfsfnjkfvv |Lot code for the goods item. Required when lot code management is enabled for the goods. If the same goods_id appears in multiple cartons, use the same lot_code and expiration_timestamp in every occurrence. | ^^expiration_timestamp |string |N |1623812664 |The goods item's expiration time as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Required when shelf-life management is enabled for the goods. It must be no earlier than the current time plus the goods-specific inbound_cutoff_days. Obtain this value from data.goods[].lot_expiration_info.inbound_cutoff_days in Search Goods Info (POST /fbt/202607/goods/search). If the same goods_id appears in multiple cartons, use the same expiration_timestamp and lot_code in every occurrence. | ^quantity |int |Y |2 |Number of physical cartons represented by this carton entry. | ^carton_nums |[]string |N |["C0001","C0002"] |Carton numbers for the physical cartons represented by this carton entry. Either omit carton_nums from every carton to have carton numbers generated automatically, or provide it for every carton. When provided, each value must consist of C followed by four digits, values must be unique across the request, and the number of values must equal quantity. | ^box_measurements |object |Y | |Carton measurement. | ^^weight |string |Y |10 |Carton weight. | ^^weight_unit |string |Y |POUNDS |The unit used for the carton's weight.

Possible values:

  • KILOGRAM (kg)
  • GRAM (g)
  • MILLIGRAM (mg)
  • POUNDS (lbs)
  • OUNCE (oz) | ^^width |string |Y |20 |Carton width. | ^^height |string |Y |2 |Carton height. | ^^length |string |Y |3 |Carton length. | ^^length_unit |string |Y |INCH |The unit used for the carton's length, width, and height.

Possible values:

  • METER (m)
  • CENTIMETER (cm)
  • MILLIMETER (mm)
  • FOOT (ft)
  • MICRON (μm)
  • INCH (in) | shipment_option |object |Y | |Shipment option containing freight type and shipping method. | ^shipping_method |string |Y |SMALL_PARCEL |Shipping method. Possible values: SMALL_PARCEL (small parcel shipping); FREIGHT (freight shipping). | ^freight_type |string |N |FTL |Freight load type. Required when shipping_method is FREIGHT for EU and UK shops. It is optional for US shops and is not required when shipping_method is SMALL_PARCEL.

Possible values:

  • FTL
  • LTL |
